_comment: The Descenders club config: the hand-maintained half of the database. Normalize never writes
any of it, and editing it never implies a re-ingest.
IDENTITY IS NOT IN THIS FILE. This repository is public and the riders are minors, so a rider
here is a stable key and a plate mapping and nothing that names anyone. Real names live in a
separate JSON map of key -> display name kept OUTSIDE the working tree. The payload corpus
now lives in-tree behind .gitignore and a pre-commit hook (docs/fixtures.md); no such guard
covers a path under config/, so identity stays where an accidental `git add` is impossible
rather than merely blocked. Seeding merges the names in when the file is present; with no names
file every rider seeds as its own pseudonym (rider-a seeds as «RIDER-A»), the redaction form
docs/fixtures.md names.
~/.local/share/bike_race_results/config/rider-names.json
{ "rider-a": "Firstname Lastname", ... }
The roster below is the club's 2025 plate set as the league published it, one rider per plate.
That is the honest starting point, not an adjudication: a rider who changed plates mid-season is
two entries here until a coach merges them into one rider with two bounded plates, and a reissued
plate is one entry until a coach splits it. Bounds are league round ordinals and are inclusive;
omit them for the whole season, which is the common case.
{ "key": "rider-a", "plates": [ { "plate": "204", "toRound": 2 },
{ "plate": "886", "fromRound": 3 } ] }
A bare string is the unbounded whole-season form and is shorthand for { "plate": "202" }.
Squads are a coaching lens, not a scoring unit, and they carry no history. One squad holding the
roster is the starting point; split it into real practice groups by editing here.
